title: docs(spec): component-member read points, held-back moves and other spellings to the ledger, part 3 of 3
body:
Part of #23434

Clause-②: no

Part 3 of 3 of PR-2 for issue 23434. The issue stays open after it lands, for the remainder named below. It executes ruling 6165388570 (letter C, items 1 and 4) and ruling 6181034096 (Q2 → A, Q1 → A), under claim 6181304005. Parts 1 and 2 are #23589 and #23590, which move the records in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`. All three branch from `origin/main`; none is stacked on another.

## What this part changes

**Item 1, group C outside `component.zod.ts`.** The component-member read points in `component.test.ts` move into `liveness/page.json`, row `regions`, as do those in the `component-*.pin.test.ts` family (action-member params, form custom-fields, form / list / metric families, object-grid declared keys and typed members, objectui-held members, `z.unknown()` members, report-items / action members), the record-block tests (approvals / attachments, field security, record blocks, reference rail), the action-row and element-navigation tests, `expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts`, `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`, `page.zod.ts` and `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`. Where a test record carried a reading the ledger lacked, it became an entry or a clause of an entry: the `page:tabs` retired `type`, the icon vocabulary table, the static-params drop, the drill-down writer pins, the grid's `AggregationType`, the page-builder guide, the object-manager dialog writer, the bindable-text rows, `PageComponent.visibleWhen` roots and the PLANNED `dataSource` API binding. `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`'s two mirror citations went to their own rows (`view.json` `list.appearance`, `dashboard.json` `widgets`), not to `page.regions`.

**Item 2, the two held-back moves**, applied as PR-1's hold-back reversed (`git diff 7fe6ffdde1 7ebc084841` over the four files, which were byte-identical on `origin/main`):
- `src/ui/dataset.zod.ts` → `liveness/dataset.json`, row `measures.format`.
- `src/data/api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` → `liveness/object.json`, row `enable.apiMethods`.

Changed lines: 1,754 (+336 / -1,418) across 49 files, under the 3,000-line review line. Head `be8657fa44`, which contains merge `7ea3bb007d` of `origin/main`.

## Census, base `7ffc57846a` → all three parts merged

`page.regions` note: 120 entries, 62,138 characters. No schema or gate caps a note's length. Only `evidence` and `producer` are path-scanned by `check:liveness`, and `note` is free text that the lint layer never shows an author.

## How the three parts were measured

The three parts were built from one verified union branch, `claude/issue-23434-pin-citations-pr2` at `1646d39e53` (all three parts' changes in one tree). The split was then checked mechanically:

- `git merge-tree` of part 1 + part 2 + part 3 onto `origin/main` gives a tree whose `packages/spec` and `content` match the union head exactly (empty diff). The three parts merge in any order without conflict. They share one changed line in `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` (the `regions` note), and it is byte-identical in all three.
- Comment-only: every changed `.ts` file was parsed with TypeScript and compared with `origin/main` on its code tokens, JSDoc and comments excluded. All published files are identical. In this part's head, five string literals changed across two test files: two test names, one `why` reason string, and the two pieces of one assertion message. No schema, type, export, default, accept or refuse change, and no `.describe()` text change.
- Every `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` in the new evidence list and in the edited ledger notes was resolved against an objectui clone at that SHA: the file exists and the symbol occurs in it. 656 references in the 120 entries and 32 in the other notes; 0 unresolved. A negative control (a bogus path and two bogus symbols) reported 3 of 3.

Union head `1646d39e53`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `check-generated.ts --fix`: 1 of 14 artefacts stale (`content/docs/references/ui/expression-bindable-text-keys.mdx`, from part 3's shortened docblock), regenerated. The re-check afterwards: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts and test typecheck): exit 0.
- `vitest run --project local`: Test Files 678 passed (678), Tests 20728 passed, 1 todo.
- `vitest run --project repo`: Test Files 61 passed (61), Tests 1033 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, each exit code captured before any pipe, then `--ran`: "103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 99 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED". The 4 recorded exit 3 (prerequisite not built): lint `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. One RED that comes from the base, not this diff: `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 with ABSENT SYMBOL findings in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{access-security,attachments-storage,search}.json`. They point at `packages/metadata-protocol` and `service-storage`, which no part touches; PR-1 reported the same findings. The other 98 exited 0, including `check:liveness`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations` and `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`. On the anchors gate, "citations name no tracked file" went from 1965 on the base to 228.

**This part's head `be8657fa44`**: merge `7ea3bb007d` of `origin/main`, then the past-tense fix to the `page.json` `interfaceConfig` note. Every run below was taken after the last commit, in a fresh worktree:

- Spec build: VERDICT command-exit 0. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `vitest run --project local`: Test Files 678 passed (678), Tests 20728 passed, 1 todo. `--project repo`: Test Files 61 passed (61), Tests 1033 passed. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The targeted run first, `src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation` and `src/ui/component`: Test Files 28 passed (28), Tests 1542 passed.
- `check:generated` ("All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"), `check:liveness`, `check:issue-citations`, `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` and `check:nul-bytes`: all exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, then `--ran`: "111 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". No STALE TREE note. Seven families first exited 3 because the fresh worktree had no built prerequisites. After `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2` (lock VERDICT 0), all seven re-ran at exit 0: lint `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. 110 exit 0. One RED, from the base: `check:platform-checklist`, exit 1, the same 7 ABSENT SYMBOL findings (`areas/access-security.json` 5, `attachments-storage.json` 1, `search.json` 1); no part touches those paths.

## Acceptance notes

**Deviations from the claim, stated rather than chosen silently:**

1. **Split by file range, not strictly by item.** The measured union diff is 7,395 changed lines. Item 1 alone is over 3,000, because `component.zod.ts` alone is 5,675 lines. So `component.zod.ts` splits into two halves at an unchanged 33-line gap (parts 1 and 2, 2,770 and 2,931 lines). Item 1's remaining files ride here with items 2 and 3. Every part carries the identical `page.regions` line so that each part's ledger is complete; a `git merge-tree` of all three onto `origin/main` reproduces the verified union tree.
2. **The claim's item 1 names `component.zod.ts` only.** Seat 3's group C, the 99 that ruling 6181034096 counts, spans 15 files: `component.zod.ts`, `component.test.ts`, the `component-*.pin` tests, `expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts`, `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`, `page.zod.ts` and `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`. I followed the ruling's 99. Some tombstone docblocks inside `component.zod.ts` (`sortField`, `resizableColumns`, `defaultSort`, `quickAdd`, form `layout` `inline`/`grid`) were moved, per seat 3's file-based classification. Their `migrations/entries` and retirement-test counterparts (group R) are untouched.
3. **Branches.** Part 3 lands from the claimed branch. Its history holds the WIP commits of the verified union, which a squash discards. Parts 1 and 2 are new branches cut from `origin/main`.

**Left in place on purpose (census remainder after all three parts):**

- **Retirement history, the class ruling 6181034096 keeps.** It is not limited to the 40 in the ruling's three locations: `integration/connector.test.ts` (`errorMapping` retired, objectui `0d8fd7c`), `system/email-template.zod.ts` (`category` / `isSystem` retired), `ui/app.zod.ts` (`homePageId` tombstone, objectui `@785b8a5d`), `ui/dashboard.zod.ts` (`actionUrl` / `actionType` / `actionIcon` removed, `objectui@91757a7`), `ui/view.zod.ts` (`responsive` / `performance` removed, `objectui@fb35e48`) and `api/export-job-family-retirement.test.ts`.
- **No matching ledger row, so reported here and given no invented row:**
  - `ai/build-progress.zod.ts` (objectui `dda8f3815`; the build-progress phase vocabulary; no ledger file covers AI stream frames).
  - `api/dataset-selection.test.ts` (objectui `@98178b2`; the five call sites that build a runtime `DatasetSelection`, which is a request rather than dataset metadata).
  - `system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:578-579` (seven `view` keys the ledger walk cannot hold, as that comment itself says).
  - `ui/view-console-round-trip-keys.test.ts:19,42` and the matching `ui/view.zod.ts` round-trip census (`VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`, sha-less pin); the walk stops at the union's container arm.
- **objectui commit references, which mark a change and are not read points:** 14 in the component files, plus `kernel/functional-completeness.ts` (`afb228418`, `5f4514f7b`, `fec3b1a8b`, `04a67b9dc`), `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` (`29b99490`), and `ui/page.zod.ts` / `ui/view.zod.ts` (`b434f5f47`, `0253416`). Three of these sentences said "at the pin"; they now read "on the console this repo ships" or use the past tense.
- **A third spelling, outside the claim's two.** These are sha-less `File.tsx:NNN` citations with neither a SHA nor a pin mention. They do not claim to track the pin, so a pin hop never forces their rewrite. There are 17 lines in 8 published source files: `ai/build-progress.zod.ts`, `data/field.zod.ts` (2), `ui/action.zod.ts` (3), `ui/app.zod.ts`, `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, `ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, `ui/i18n-label-resolver.ts` and `ui/view.zod.ts` (6). There are also 40 in tests: 30 of them in the pin tests name the objectui TEST file a fixture's shape was copied from (writer provenance, not a renderer read point). These stay for a later round under #23434, which stays open: ruling item 1's last sentence covers them.

**Measured drift (zone 2):**

- Counts: group C is 66 historical spellings on the retired gate's `--list`, plus the respelled ones (27 of PR-1's "re-read there 2026-10-14" form across the component files and the two held-back files). Group R holds at 34 historical citations, unchanged. One new live historical citation landed after PR-1: `ui/action-declarative-update.ts` (#23494), moved here.
- Note capacity: nothing caps a note. `regions` now holds 62,138 characters.
- Only read points moved: commit references, in-repo anchors and retirement records stayed. Each record's per-hop chain went with its read points.
- One stale claim was dropped rather than moved. `component.test.ts` said the tree renderer reads `data` through the `'undeclared'` arm (true at objectui `87af769e9`). At objectui `b9814b334` it is the `'view-data'` arm. The ledger entry records the current reading.

**Merge note:** #23568 removed the `interfaceConfig.emptyState` omit row from `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` on main. The merge (`7ea3bb007d`) took main's side, and this part no longer touches that file.

- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.
- No label written: `skip-changeset` does not apply, because a published file changes and the patch changeset is present.
